indicator_name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
source_organization: World Bank World Development Indicators; underlying source: International Telecommunication Union
methodology: Individuals who used the Internet from any location in the last three months, expressed as a percentage of the population.
notes: This indicator does not measure household broadband availability, device access or quality, connection quality, affordability, digital skills, or demand for online learning.
